title: Exceed collection duration or challenge expiry boundaries
preconditions: the profile has a finite collection ceiling and the challenge has a half-open validity window
steps: extend collection beyond the effective profile or tighter publisher ceiling
delay proof or transport until the exact challenge expiry boundary
request skew normalization or an invented post-freeze latency field
invariants: the immutable profile sets a finite collection ceiling and publisher policy may only tighten it
challenge validity uses the existing half-open expiry boundary
no unverifiable post-freeze latency field or skew allowance is invented
residual_risk: challenge expiry bounds but does not independently measure proof and transport latency after freeze
